meta.revisionPolicy: Revised continuously; finalised over ~3 years. Vintages are kept.
meta.coverage: All-India, annual, by institutional sector (households, private and public non-financial and financial companies, general government): gross saving, fixed investment, GVA and depreciation, levels and shares of nominal GDP
meta.note: Institutional-sector accounts are published with the revised estimates only. Saving, GVA and depreciation by sector are at current prices only. 'Saving less fixed investment' is computed here: a sector with a positive figure lends its surplus to the others; it ignores stocks and valuables, which are not published by sector. Households include non-profit institutions serving households (NPISH).
